description: This file defines the ProductionRun class used within the OFBiz manufacturing module to manage production runs, including scheduling, quantities, routing, and related entities. It provides methods for retrieving, updating, and recalculating production run data.

classes.name: ProductionRun
classes.description: Represents a manufacturing production run with scheduling, quantities, routing, and related entities, with methods to manipulate and recalculate production data.

methods.name: ProductionRun
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ProductionRun object from a production run ID, fetching related data from the database.

methods.name: exist
methods.description: Checks if the production run exists.

methods.name: getGenericValue
methods.description: Returns the underlying GenericValue representing the production run.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Persists changes to the production run and related entities in the database.

methods.name: getProductProduced
methods.description: Retrieves the product associated with the production run.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity to produce.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets a new quantity to produce and adjusts related components accordingly.

methods.name: getEstimatedStartDate
methods.description: Gets the estimated start date of the production run.

methods.name: setEstimatedStartDate
methods.description: Sets the estimated start date.

methods.name: getEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the estimated completion date based on routing tasks.

methods.name: setEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Sets the estimated completion date.

methods.name: recalculateEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Recomputes the estimated completion date based on routing tasks and start date.

methods.name: recalculateEstimatedCompletionDate
methods.description: Recomputes the estimated completion date from the estimated start date and routing.

methods.name: getProductionRunName
methods.description: Returns the name of the production run.

methods.name: setProductionRunName
methods.description: Sets the name of the production run.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of the production run.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description.

methods.name: getCurrentStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status entity of the production run.

methods.name: getProductionRunComponents
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components required for the production run.

methods.name: getProductionRunRoutingTasks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of routing tasks associated with the production run.

methods.name: getLastProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Returns the last routing task based on priority.

methods.name: clearRoutingTasksList
methods.description: Clears the cached list of routing tasks to force re-fetch.

methods.name: getEstimatedTaskTime
methods.description: Static method to estimate task duration based on task, quantity, and dispatcher.
